lines.en: I walk over the snow.
My axe drags along the ground.
My footprints sink deep.
I drop down from high above.
The wind carries me a step.
Frost crusts my fur.
I circle the snowy slope.
My claws scrape loudly.
I leave deep pits in the snow.
The snowfield has no end.
I walk with the axe blade on my back.
The cold wind sharpens me.
I am honing my axe.
Snow settles on my back.
This place is too warm.
The wind finds the way for me.
I count the falling flakes.
Who watches from above?
I draw a breath of cold air.
The snow crunches under my claws.
I sway my tail.
This body does not tire.
I slowly raise the axe.
Waiting for something to come close.
I warm the axe haft in my grip.
I cannot see the sun.
The snowfield is quiet.
Just a little longer.
You stepped into my snowfield.
You give off heat.
How do you plan to dodge an axe?
Your knuckles have gone white.
One step closer and the axe comes down.
The edges of your boots aren't frozen yet.
Have you come to hunt a wolf?
I smell that the cold frightens you.
Your boots will soak through.
I move first, then you.
Why are you looking up at me?
The snow is keeping your footprints.

lines.zh: 你的脚印跑不出这片雪
lines.en: Your tracks won't run past this snow.
This whiteness is mine.
You cut into my fur.
I drag my axe and pull back.

lines.zh: 斧柄在我爪里滑了一寸
lines.en: The haft slips an inch in my paw.
My growl rises over the snow.
The frost shook off me.
My leg has gone stiff.
You dare come back for more.

lines.zh: 霜从我的伤口边长起来
lines.en: Frost crusts over the edge of my wound.
The wound feels cold in the snow.
I have not even swung my axe.
That thing is warm.
I saw what you held out.
I need no food, but I want it.
Put it down and step back.

lines.zh: 热的东西在雪里很显眼
lines.en: Warm things stand out in snow.
I smell iron.
I edge toward that warmth.
Do not take it back.
This one is mine.
Hold that warm thing steady.
You rammed my flank.
I stand firm in snow.
Do not hit my axe haft.
I shift my weight and you fall back.
I stand a head above you.
One bump and you are off balance.
We kicked the snow apart.

lines.zh: 我抬起斧头就没再放下
lines.en: I lift my axe and keep it up.
Do not press against my fur.
Bump me again and I swing.
Only the two of us on this snowfield.
The wind will carry the scent away.
Do not stand downwind.
I left my axe far away.
It will be quick.
The colder the better.
We are not a pair.
Do not come near my back.
Snow will cover the traces.
I will not remember you.
There are things in the snow too.
I pin it with a claw.
What falls is mine.
Some dark copper, good.
I pick it up and do not let go.
Cold, just right.
I bury it in the snow.
Whoever dropped it, it is the same.
I can carry it in one paw.
I will keep this.

lines.zh: 我的斧头已经举起来了
lines.en: My axe is already up.
The wind has you pinned.
You stepped in my snow.
Do not think of slipping downhill.

lines.zh: 斧刃越过我的肩膀举起
lines.en: The axe blade rises past my shoulder.
This swing will not miss.
The frost on my back bursts.
You breathe too loudly.
There is nowhere to hide in snow.
My axe is above my shoulder.
Do not turn, I am watching.
The wind blade comes first.
I set the wind circling you.
I know wherever you run.
The axe is heavy, so I take my time.
The wind blade skims the ground.
You are retreating into the snow.
The snow light sharpens my sight.
I left you one way out.
That way leads nowhere.
The axe edge tracks your breathing.
The snow is sinking under you.

lines.zh: 我在雪上一步步压过去
lines.en: I press across the snow, step by step.
My wind blade skims the ground and curls behind you.
You've turned your back to me.
I chop down from above.
A sweeping cut of wind.
My axe grazes your shoulder.
You are thrown into the snow.
The wind blade chases you.
I swing with full force.
You blocked the haft.
This blow carries frost.
Do not rush to strike back.
I have not pulled my axe back yet.

lines.zh: 我从高处的雪里落下来
lines.en: I come down from the snow above.
The wind arrives first, then me.
This snowfield has a master now.
Frost begins on my fur.
I heard snow being crushed.
I rise, dragging my axe.
Who dirtied this place?
Cold air woke me.
My axe hits the snow before I do.
Snow dusts my whole body.
Fine wind in this place.
I will stay in this white.
Frost creeps upward through my fur.
Someone is out there.
Fire melted the snow around me.
I crashed from high into a drift.
Cold water soaks through my fur.
The blast shook loose the snow.
An arrow stands in my back.
Charms hold my limbs down.
There is nothing to eat on this snowfield.
Lightning ran down my axe into me.
The snowfield fell away.
